body.text: The Supreme Court's long conference is today, and the Ninth Circuit majority that upheld Hawaii's permit rules said it hopes the Justices will settle the footnote-nine question.

The full Yukutake opinions are now readable: the majority treats non-abusive shall-issue rules as presumptively valid; five dissenters say footnote nine created no such test. No orders released and no petition reported; the ruling binds nine western states and changes no law.
